unit.title: Sampling and Rasterization: Build a Deterministic Triangle Rasterizer
unit.scope: One bounded implementation-and-testing unit; it is not a reconstruction of a CMU assignment or lecture.
prerequisites: Basic linear algebra, including 2D vectors and affine combinations
Asymptotic analysis and familiarity with invariants
learning_objectives: Relate pixel-center sampling to discrete triangle coverage.
Implement orientation-independent half-space coverage with a consistent shared-edge convention.
Use barycentric coordinates to interpolate vertex color.
Turn numerical and input edge cases into explicit, testable behavior.
Package the implementation as a reproducible command-line program with automated tests.
deliverables: A C++17 rasterizer library and rasterize command-line executable
A CMake/CTest build with deterministic automated tests
README.md with exact build, test, and run commands
ENGINEERING_NOTES.md documenting invariants, complexity, numerical decisions, and limitations
Captured build and test evidence generated from the submitted revision
